Which player has participated in the highest number of winning matches and which player has participated in the highest number of losing matches, considering only matches where they actually played (excluding null entries) and where their team won or lost (excluding draws)?

content.text: I will first identify all matches that did not result in a draw. Then, for each of these matches, I will determine the winning and losing teams. I will then create a list of all players who participated in these matches, for both winning and losing teams, making sure to exclude any null entries for players. After this, I will calculate the total number of wins and losses for each player. Finally, I will identify the player with the highest number of wins and the player with the highest number of losses and present these two players as the result.

args.sql:
WITH PlayerMatchOutcomes AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(t.player_position, 'home') > 0 AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'win'
            WHEN INSTR(t.player_position, 'away') > 0 AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'win'
            ELSE 'loss'
        END AS outcome
    FROM
        Match AS m,
        UNPIVOT (VALUES(home_player_1, 'home_player_1'), (home_player_2, 'home_player_2'), (home_player_3, 'home_player_3'), 
                      (home_player_4, 'home_player_4'), (home_player_5, 'home_player_5'), (home_player_6, 'home_player_6'), 
                      (home_player_7, 'home_player_7'), (home_player_8, 'home_player_8'), (home_player_9, 'home_player_9'), 
                      (home_player_10, 'home_player_10'), (home_player_11, 'home_player_11'), 
                      (away_player_1, 'away_player_1'), (away_player_2, 'away_player_2'), (away_player_3, 'away_player_3'), 
                      (away_player_4, 'away_player_4'), (away_player_5, 'away_player_5'), (away_player_6, 'away_player_6'), 
                      (away_player_7, 'away_player_7'), (away_player_8, 'away_player_8'), (away_player_9, 'away_player_9'), 
                      (away_player_10, 'away_player_10'), (away_player_11, 'away_player_11')) AS t(player_api_id, player_position)
    JOIN
        Player AS p ON t.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE
        m.home_team_goal != m.away_team_goal
        AND t.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
PlayerStats AS (
    SELECT
        player_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
    FROM
        PlayerMatchOutcomes
    GROUP BY
        player_name
),
MostWins AS (
    SELECT 'Most Wins' AS category, player_name, wins AS count
    FROM PlayerStats
    ORDER BY wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
MostLosses AS (
    SELECT 'Most Losses' AS category, player_name, losses AS count
    FROM PlayerStats
    ORDER BY losses DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM MostWins
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM MostLosses;
